mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), increasing sulfamethoxazole metabolism and reducing its plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response and consider increasing sulfamethoxazole dose or selecting alternative antibiotics if therapeutic failure occurs; ensure adequate dosing of sulfamethoxazole when used concurrently with rifampin.
